earnings.title: Las Vegas Sands Reports
highlights: Net revenue was $3.22 billion, compared to $3.33 billion in the prior year quarter.
LVS Repurchased $950 million of Common Stock During the Quarter

quotes.text: We continued to execute our strategic objectives during the quarter in both Singapore and Macao while increasing the return of capital to shareholders, including through the repurchase of $950 million of our common stock during the quarter.
quotes.by: Patrick Dumont, chairman and chief executive officer

items.heading: We depend on the continued services of key personnel.
